templates.title: DockRoute
templates.name: dockroute
templates.description: External-DNS for plain Docker hosts: watches running containers, reads dockroute.* labels and reconciles the matching DNS records — and Cloudflare Tunnel routes — in a pluggable provider. TXT-based ownership means it never alters records it cannot prove it manages.
templates.note: Socket permissions are handled automatically: the entrypoint grants the app user the Docker socket's group and drops privileges before starting. Start with the default log provider for a zero-credential dry run, then switch to cloudflare. Opt containers in with labels: dockroute.enabled=true and dockroute.hostname=app.example.com. Docs: https://www.dockroute.dev — Source: https://github.com/Dockroute/Dockroute

env.name: DOCKROUTE_PROVIDER
env.label: Provider
env.description: DNS provider. 'log' is a dry run that only prints the desired state.

env.name: DOCKROUTE_OWNER_ID
env.label: Owner ID
env.description: Ownership id written to companion TXT records; lets several instances share a zone safely.

env.name: DOCKROUTE_POLICY
env.label: Sync policy
env.description: sync = create/update/delete owned records; upsert-only = never delete; create-only = never update or delete.

env.name: DOCKROUTE_DELETE_GRACE_SECONDS
env.label: Delete grace (seconds)
env.description: Seconds a record must stay gone before DockRoute deletes it. Protects against container restarts; 0 deletes immediately.

env.name: DOCKROUTE_DEFAULT_TARGET
env.label: Default target
env.description: Fallback record value (IP or CNAME target) when a container omits the dockroute.target label.

env.name: DOCKROUTE_DOMAIN_FILTER
env.label: Domain filter
env.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of DNS zones DockRoute may touch. Empty = all zones the token can see.

env.name: DOCKROUTE_RESYNC_SECONDS
env.label: Resync interval (seconds)
env.description: Interval of the periodic full reconcile that backs up the event stream.

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
env.label: Cloudflare API token
env.description: Required when provider is cloudflare. Needs Zone → DNS → Edit (+ Account → Cloudflare Tunnel → Edit for tunnel publishing).

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
env.label: Cloudflare account ID
env.description: Only needed for Cloudflare Tunnel publishing.

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_ID
env.label: Cloudflare tunnel ID
env.description: Only needed for Cloudflare Tunnel publishing. Uses an existing tunnel — you keep running cloudflared yourself.
